landing.heroTitleAccent: Safe for every condition at the table.
landing.heroDesc: When parents live with diabetes, blood pressure, or kidney restrictions and children have food allergies, cooking three separate meals every evening burns caregivers out. Harbor plans one shared family dish with a single-step split when needed—and times medicine reminders cleanly to real meals.
landing.heroMetric3: Zero health details on lock screens
landing.previewTitle: Tap a family member to see how dinner adapts
landing.previewSafeDesc: Safe for everyone with a single-step split before final seasoning.
landing.previewSplitTag: Set aside 1 bowl before salt & spices
landing.previewSplitNote: Father's kidney-friendly & Mother's low-sodium portions separated cleanly from the same pot.
landing.previewBlockedReason: Automatically held back — Arif has a prawn allergy.
landing.featuresTitle: Quiet coordination across meals, pantry, and medicine
landing.feature1Title: One pot when possible, an effortless split when needed
landing.feature1Desc: Every family recipe is checked against allergies, active medicines, and dietary limits—showing clearly what is directly safe, when one bowl comes out early, and why unsafe dishes stay off the menu.
landing.feature1Point1: Clear visual badges for every condition and allergen
landing.feature1Point2: Guests and away members adjust servings automatically
landing.feature2Title: Reminders timed to breakfast, lunch, and dinner
landing.feature2Desc: Elder family members receive one oversized, high-contrast confirmation screen synced to real household mealtimes—with zero disease or medicine names ever exposed on lock screens.
landing.feature2PrivacyNote: Lock screen shows only: Time for medicine
landing.feature3Title: Speak or type pantry updates in everyday Bangla, stay on budget
landing.feature3Desc: Log market runs, spoiled vegetables, or guests in natural Bangla and review every change before saving. Harbor tracks expiring stock and recommends seasonal swaps to protect monthly budgets.
landing.feature3VoiceSample: "Bought 1 kg bottle gourd, half the oil is finished"
landing.rhythmTitle: Designed around a calm household rhythm
landing.rhythmMorningDesc: Patient screens show only when a dose is due, while caregivers see calm confirmation status from their own phone.
landing.rhythmAfternoonTitle: Voice-logged market bags update tonight's stock
landing.rhythmAfternoonDesc: Say what came home from the bazar in Bangla; confirm the clean summary chip in one tap without touching spreadsheets.
landing.rhythmEveningTitle: One pot hits the stove with zero guesswork
landing.rhythmEveningDesc: Everyone eats together safely, and cooked ingredients deduct cleanly so tomorrow's menu prioritizes what is fresh.
landing.trust1Desc: Uploaded prescriptions are read transiently and immediately discarded after your review—only confirmed medicine schedules are stored.
landing.trust2Desc: Every parsed voice note or guest change stays as an editable preview until the caregiver taps Confirm.
landing.trust3Desc: Switch seamlessly between Bangla and English or Light and Dark mode across every caregiver and patient screen.
landing.closingTitle: Bring calmer evenings to your family table.
landing.closingDesc: Set up your household in under two minutes or explore the pre-loaded Hossain family demo.
landing.step1Desc: Speak pantry updates or review prescription drafts without manual spreadsheets.
landing.step2Desc: Allergies, dietary restrictions, and meal conflicts are checked cleanly every time.
landing.step3Desc: Meal-timed alerts keep elderly family members on schedule with dignified privacy.

eval.title: 30-Case Safety Benchmark & Evaluation
eval.subtitle: Compares a plain LLM baseline against Harbor's deterministic engine across allergy, multi-condition, and drug-food scenarios.
eval.notRunBody: Harbor only reports verified benchmark measurements. No evaluation numbers have been generated yet.
eval.caveatsItem1: Benchmark cases (eval/cases.json) were authored by the coding agent and labelled from the seed rule table (ingredients, drug-food rules, and diet presets) — not an external human clinician.
eval.caveatsItem2: Harbor's 0.0% unsafe rate holds by construction against the same seed rule table (verifying deterministic rule adherence, not independent clinical validation).
eval.caveatsItem3: In Baseline Run 1 (eval/results.json, 90 runs, max_tokens=500), the plain model scored 0/30 unsafe on allergy cases (A01-A10), while 27 runs failed due to reasoning-token truncation (json_validate_failed) and a Groq 200k TPD 429 rate limit on D10. A subsequent re-run attempt (eval/results_run2_INVALID.json) hit HTTP 429 on 26/30 cases and is excluded as unusable.

howItWorks.title: How Harbor Keeps Families Safe
howItWorks.subtitle: Architectural overview: strict separation between natural-language parsing and pure-Python clinical safety decisions.
howItWorks.card1Body: LLMs (Groq & Gemini) only transcribe Bangla speech, extract draft prescription rows without doses, and summarize explanations. Only deterministic Python evaluates allergens, confirmed drug classes, age rules, and diet presets.
howItWorks.card2Body: If a prescription row or pantry ingredient is unrecognized, affected dishes evaluate to UNVERIFIED and stay excluded. Nothing enters active schedules or stock ledgers until signed off by the caregiver.
howItWorks.card3Body: Every generated dish explanation is verified token-by-token against the engine's deterministic output. If any detail drifts or an API fails, Harbor serves a deterministic EN/BN template automatically.
howItWorks.card4Body: Prescription photos and audio clips never touch disk or database columns. Patient reminder views and push notifications contain strictly generic phrasing with zero disease or medicine disclosure.
